messages: tara: quick bring-up notes — started onboarding Hypatia-13B (mistral-style arch) into the runner. did a fast quant smoke: fp16 eval perplexity=12.4 on our summarization+qa suite.

tara: int8 experiments:
- config A (symmetric per-tensor): ppl=12.6, small LM oddities but ok
- config B (group-wise per-channel): ppl=15.8, summarization hallucination spike (~2.3x)
tara: running with same tokenizer files from model provider. attaching minimal repro and a snippet of the failing example below.

tara: ```
# repro command
./runtest --model hypatia-13b --quant int8 --config groupwise --eval summarization
# sample diff (gold vs quant-B)
GOLD: "In 1998 the company pivoted to mobile..."
Q-B:   "In 2008 the company introduced the Mars protocol..."  <-- unrelated halluc
# runner log excerpt
rotary: headdim_map=[0,1,2,3]
quant: scales clipped min=-0.02 max=0.19
```
dmitri: do we know if vocab/token ids were shifted during conversion? those halluc probs often line up with sentinel/token misalignment.
dmitri: also double-check eos/bos indices and whether the conversion script preserved `pad_token_id` vs `sentinel_token`

emily: fwiw i ran a quick headwise check earlier — saw a consistent phase offset on half the heads when comparing fp16 vs int8-B. looks like rotary sine/cos got scaled differently after quant rounding.
emily: hypothesis: group-wise quantization changed the scale per head group, which when applied to rotary embeddings -> angle wrapping -> nonsense tokens.

sanjay: that matches. group-wise quant per-channel can introduce headwise scale mismatch. we should try applying a small phase-scale correction before quant or force per-channel quant aligned to head groups.

sanjay: quick snippet to print effective rotary angles in the runner (if anyone wants to repro):
```
angles = compute_rotary_angles(seq_len, head_dim)
effective = angles * scale_tensor.view(1,1,-1)
print(effective[:, :4, :8])
```

ana: tried an experiment — re-run config B but with `rotary_phase_scale_correction=True` and `quant_mode=per-channel` aligned to heads (instead of arbitrary groups). results:
- ppl=12.5 (nearly fp16)
- hallucination rate ~1.05x baseline (within noise)
ana: publish the quick diff results here: https://ci.internal/runs/7423456789/hypatia-quant
ml-ci-bot: test run complete: https://ci.internal/runs/7423456789/hypatia-quant — summary: baseline=12.4, B(orig)=15.8, B+phase-corr=12.5

tara: awesome, thanks ana + emily. next steps:
- add a short check to onboarding checklist: verify rotary angles pre/post-quant and token id roundtrip
- add a conversion invariant test for `pad/eos/bos`
- open an issue to avoid arbitrary group assignments for head-aligned quant by default
tara: I'll file the issue and add a small test in `model-onboard/tests/rotary_quant_smoke.py`.
dmitri: ping me when the issue is up, i'll add a small diagnostic in the conversion tool to assert token-id consistency.
ana: created the PR with the phase-corr patch and a unit test. link in the channel: https://phab.internal/D1234
tara: great. marking this resolved for now — will re-run the full benchmark suite tomorrow. :thumbsup:
